description.narrative: The activity will enable 6 participants in the 'Faith for Freedom-project to participate in the 11th International Conference on Freedom of Religious Belief (FoRB) in Bangkok, 20-21 of August 2026. The conference will 1. Examine the state of religious freedom in Asia. 2. Identify threats to religious freedom and current responses. 3. Build strategies and actions for advancing religious freedom in the region And as seen in attached concept note the conference will focus on FoRB as a Human Right, Legal and Structural Restrictions on Religious Freedom, Division of Courts, Bureaucratic Control of Religion, Religious Freedom in Conflict Zones, Transnational Repression of Religious Activists, Religious Fundamentalism, State-Sanctioned Religion, Uncivil Society and Social Hostilities against FoRB Representation and Marginalisation, Online Harassment, Gender, Religion, and Intersectional Discrimination, Indigenous People, Atheists, and Non-Believers From Tolerance to Accountability
